name: skill_create
description: Create a new local skill under .projectflows/skill/. Writes a SKILL.md with the provided frontmatter and body, registers it immediately (no session restart needed), and returns the skill directory path. Use the write/edit tools afterward to add optional scripts, agents, or reference files to the same directory.

name.description: Skill name (used as directory name and registry key, e.g. 'my-skill')

description.description: One-line description of when to trigger this skill and what it does

content.description: Markdown body of the SKILL.md (the instructions agents will follow)
